description: Canonical capability vocabulary an artifact can provide and an analyzer can require or optionally use. Source of truth is src/DumpDetective.Sdk/Artifacts/CapabilityVocabulary.cs; this file is the checked-in, versioned mirror docs/refactor/modularity/phase-1-contracts-sdk.md calls for, validated against the code by tests/DumpDetective.Tests/Unit/Architecture/SdkRegistryConformanceTests.cs. Regenerate/verify with: dotnet run --project tools/CapabilityRegistryAudit (scaffolds new entries and flags them for curation; never guesses addedIn/note). See docs/refactor/modularity/source-model.md § 3.

heap.reachability.note: Split out from heap.dominators in 1.2.0 (see phase-1-sdk-review-findings.md item 4): reachability-from-root is a Stage A product, independently gated from the Stage B dominator-tree build that heap.dominators covers. Backs IHeapReachabilityQuery (src/DumpDetective.Sdk/Analysis/); not yet consumed by any migrated analyzer.

heap.dominators.note: Covers retained size, immediate dominator, and thread retention as one capability, backed by the same Stage B dominator-tree build. Narrowed in 1.2.0 when reachability (a Stage A product, independently available) was split out to heap.reachability above. Declared for the Tier-1 SDK surface (IHeapDominatorQuery, src/DumpDetective.Sdk/Analysis/) in phase-1-full-extraction-retyping-plan.md.

heap.root-paths.note: GC-root reachability paths (the !gcroot workflow) -- built for DbConnectionAnalyzer/TimerLeakAnalyzer's retyping. Backs IHeapRootPathQuery (src/DumpDetective.Sdk/Analysis/); a thin wrapper over the pre-existing dump-side RootPathFinder, not a reimplementation. phase-1-full-extraction-retyping-plan.md.

runtime.thread-pool.note: Thread-pool state (min/max/active/idle worker threads, queue length, CPU utilization) mirroring ClrRuntime.ThreadPool. Backs IRuntimeThreadPoolQuery (src/DumpDetective.Sdk/Analysis/); first real consumer HangAnalyzer, phase-1-full-extraction-retyping-plan.md.

runtime.locks.note: Declared since 1.0.0 but unconsumed until 1.1.0, when IHeapSyncBlockQuery (src/DumpDetective.Sdk/Analysis/) became its first real designed consumer, backing LockGraphAnalyzer's heap.EnumerateSyncBlocks() usage. Not yet wired to that analyzer — declared for the Tier-1 SDK surface, migration not yet done.

dump.object-fields.note: Tier 2 (phase-1-full-extraction-retyping-plan.md): per-field value reads off a live heap object. Dump-only forever, unlike every capability above -- no trace source will ever satisfy this, since traces carry no live object field layouts. Backs IDumpObjectFieldQuery (src/DumpDetective.Sdk/Analysis/). First real consumer: SqlConnectionPoolAnalyzer (Tier-2 pilot).

dump.array-elements.note: Tier 2, second dump-only capability alongside dump.object-fields: array element shape/sparse-counting. Dump-only forever for the same reason dump.object-fields is. Backs IDumpArrayShapeQuery (src/DumpDetective.Sdk/Analysis/). First real consumer: ArrayAnalyzer.

trace.cpu-samples.note: In production use since Phase 6b's CpuHotspotAnalyzer (src/DumpDetective.Sources.NetTrace/CpuHotspotAnalyzer.cs).

trace.gc-events.note: In production use since Phase 6b's GcPauseAnalyzer (src/DumpDetective.Sources.NetTrace/GcPauseAnalyzer.cs).

trace.alloc-samples.note: Declared, not yet produced by any shipped indexer or analyzer.

trace.contention-events.note: In production use since Phase 6b's ContentionAnalyzer (src/DumpDetective.Sources.NetTrace/ContentionAnalyzer.cs).

trace.exception-events.note: Declared, not yet produced by any shipped indexer or analyzer.

trace.thread-timeline.note: Declared, not yet produced by any shipped indexer or analyzer.

trace.jit-events.note: Declared, not yet produced by any shipped indexer or analyzer.

trace.http-events.note: Declared, not yet produced by any shipped indexer or analyzer.

trace.custom-events.note: Declared, not yet produced by any shipped indexer or analyzer.
